source.desc: a burly veteran male knight with short grey hair, a grey beard and a scar across his left eyebrow, wearing steel plate armor with gauntlets and armored boots, a long red cape, a brown belt, and a large greatsword strapped to his back
source.props: a large greatsword in a brown scabbard strapped diagonally across his back, its hilt sticking up above his right shoulder

notes.back: the greatsword in its scabbard lies diagonally across the back on top of the red cape; its whole length is visible, from the hilt above the right shoulder down to the tip near the left hip
